prompt: Add the file {music} as background music under the whole Splice project {project}: it should duck under speech and fade out at the end of the video. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: the music file as a sound item
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'sound' and str(media.get(i['params']['media'], {}).get('path', '')).endswith('music.wav') for i in items)

checks.name: ducked
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'sound' and i['params'].get('duck') for i in items)

checks.name: fades out
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'sound' and i.get('fadeOut', 0) > 0 for i in items)

checks.name: spans the video
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'sound' and i['length'] >= 0.9 * sum(c['length'] for c in clips) for i in items)
